'''Ben Cavin DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Ben Cavin]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-7953">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7953 DeckTech post 7953], DeckTech (Ben "Jigglypimp" Cavin, 26 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7953/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7953/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018154437/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7953/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''What does it mean to frock a jawa'''
* '''Author:''' Ben "Jigglypimp" Cavin
* '''Published:''' June 26, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Some words of wisdom from the great one:

=== Strategy ===

Use any methods to pull both fetts and the prison. Get Lando using the prison and put him down, gamble, retrieve, steal, repeat. If they want to fight, expand the port town to help you, if not, expand the casino and stick lando in the security room. Otherwise, go to them.

This deck does well against most decks. The only thing it has a real problem with is EBO. I'm taking suggestions on cards to put in to help out with the deck against it, because everybody's playing it over here.
